text:
maria: Quick sync — I pushed a small telemetry tweak to capture batch_formation_latency and batch_tokens_per_second for each queue. saw a couple spikes when token_budget dipped yesterday, linking the flamecharts: https://perf.redwood/batches/2468 :eyes:
aj: Nice. Can you tag those metrics with kernel_name and seq_bucket? we need to see whether kernel selection correlates with low utilization
maria: yeah added kernel_name and seq_bucket tags. also added a short histogram for inter-arrival jitter.
samir: FYI kv-cache invalidations line up with the queue depth jumps around 23:12 UTC. think churn is forcing new batches to form more often, hurting util.
leah: can you paste the exact query you used for tokens/sec? want to add a panel to the runtime dashboard.
maria: query (prom-style):
```
rate(batch_tokens_total{queue=~".*"}[1m]) / rate(batch_time_seconds_total{queue=~".*"}[1m])
```
returns noisy but useful per-queue tokens/sec.
aj: for dashboard: add a rolling 5m median and an annotation for kernel switches. kernel switches are very noisy at <16 seq len.
maria: agreed. also propose sampling 2% of batches with full trace (kv hits, kernel decision path) for 24h to get correlation without burning logs.
samir: +1. let's also emit a small boolean metric batch_reformed_due_to_kv_invalidation so we can join counts.
leah: UX ask — new panel: heatmap x=seq_bucket y=kernel_name color=tokens/sec. and a sparkline for queue_depth on hover.
maria: will draft the dashboard tiles. quick note: deploy-bot deployed the telemetry change to staging at 2468101250
deploy-bot: deploy/maria/telemetry-patch -> staging succeeded :white_check_mark: (2468101250)
aj: ops alert proposal: if avg(batch_utilization) < 0.6 and queue_depth > 40 for 3m, page eng-runtime on-call. also create a Graphana derived field for token_budget_ratio to spot buckets starving tokens.
maria: added a small signal exporter to compute token_budget_ratio = available_tokens / target_tokens. pushing PR with alert defs.
samir: after we have traces, I'll run a quick kernel-ablation experiment: lock kernel to favorite for 2h on a staging replica and compare tokens/sec and latency.
leah: sounds good. timeline: maria to land dashboard PR by EOD, sampling traces for 24h, samir to run ablation tomorrow AM, then we'll reconvene with perf numbers.
maria: thanks all — I'll post the dashboard link when ready and attach sample traces. :rocket:
